Absolute marker is every key >= 60. pianoSoundingPitchClasses returns mod 12 and skips the heuristic only then. A 14 or 17 beside 0–11, and 48 52 55, stay on the b304ca5 heuristic. transposePianoKeys does not throw. When source keys are all >= 60, transpose adds n and stores 60 + (result mod 12). Other keys outside 0–11 still add n without wrapping. When neither 0–11 candidate round-trips, keys are stored as 60 + pc. chord-dict.ts does not import define.ts. Guitar and ukulele packs were not edited.

{define: D9 keys 0 4 7 14} draws D F# A E (pcs 2, 6, 9, 4). D keys [62, 64] transposed by −60 stores D keys [62, 64], every key >= 60, and draws D and E (pcs 2, 4).

{define: C keys 0 2} +2 stores D keys [62, 64]. transpose() and exportCho({ semitones: 2 }) do not throw. The parsed define draws D and E (pcs 2, 4). That define −2 stores C keys [60, 62] and draws C and D (pcs 0, 2).

408-cell count stayed 17 * 12 * 2. F7sus4 keys 0 5 10 +2 stores G7sus4 keys [7, 0, 5]. Dsus2 keys 0 7 +3 stores Fsus2 keys [5, 0]. Dsus2 keys 0 7 +5 stores Gsus2 keys [0, 7] and draws G D; −5 stores Dsus2 keys [2, 9] and draws D A. D keys 0 4 7 +2 stores E keys [4, 8, 11]. C keys 0 4 7 +2 stores D keys [2, 6, 9].
